items.headline: $FUN Crashes 95% as Binance Exploiter Dumps on Uniswap
items.summary: $FUN plunged 95% in its Uniswap pool as the Binance exploiter's main address sold, also dumping $RAD and $OGN. About 580.8M unsold $FUN was moved back to a collection wallet.

items.headline: $SNX Recovered: Synthetix Secures 8.4M Stolen Tokens
items.summary: Synthetix recovered 8.4 million $SNX stolen in the Binance hack. The protocol DAO says the tokens are secured in its Safe and will be returned when Binance requests them.

items.headline: $IPX Unveils KPI-Gated Escrow for Onchain Crowdfunding
items.summary: $IPX detailed a patent-pending KPI-Gated Escrow tying crowdfunding and sponsorship payments to platform milestones, planned for its November 15, 2026 launch.

items.headline: $SCR Migration: Scroll Plans Permissioned AI Network
items.summary: Scroll detailed a permissioned AI network plan and an Ethereum token migration for $SCR, with the broader transition targeting Q2 2027. Users will need separate plans for DeFi positions.

items.headline: $JUP Lend Hit by Liquidity Crunch, Withdrawals Delayed
items.summary: Jupiter Lend says a liquidity crunch is delaying withdrawals, with just 3.35 USDC immediately withdrawable against 418.5M USDC in Earn deposit claims. $JUP holders are watching closely.
